whyChoose.heading: Why Choose VitaBlake?
whyChoose.text: VitaBlake is a UK brand under Blake Global Holdings (PVT) LTD a UK based company dedicated to bringing high-quality vitamins and supplements to Sri Lanka. Our products are manufactured in the UK by an established, quality-focused manufacturer whose products are distributed across Europe. With carefully selected ingredients, high manufacturing standards, and a strong commitment to quality, VitaBlake brings you vitamins you can trust. From trusted UK manufacturing to your hands in Sri Lanka, we are committed to delivering quality, reliability, and confidence in every product. We ensure that all our products are made to the highest British manufacturing standards.

description: Support your bones, joints and everyday mobility from within with Collagen Ultra, a convenient daily formula designed for adults who want to maintain an active and healthy lifestyle. Collagen is an important structural protein found throughout the body and plays a key role in the structure of bones, joints, cartilage and connective tissues.

The product is particularly suited to adults aged 30+, active individuals, fitness enthusiasts and those looking to support their bone and joint health as part of healthy ageing. Rather than focusing solely on beauty, Collagen Ultra is a daily wellness formula for maintaining mobility, flexibility and an active lifestyle, helping support your body's natural structural needs alongside a balanced diet and regular exercise.
In addition to hydrolysed collagen, this supplement contains glucosamine, chondroitin, vitamin C, and MSM for enhanced support.

sections.heading: What is Collagen?
sections.body: Collagen is a complex structural protein that is found in fibrous tissues within the body, such as tendons, ligaments, cartilage, bone and skin. Our collagen comes from hydrolysed fish sources. In hydrolysed collagen, the collagen bonds have been broken, leaving the essential amino acids intact and ready for digestion.

sections.heading: What Does Collagen Ultra Do?
sections.body: Collagen Ultra contains vitamin C. Vitamin C contributes to normal collagen formation for the normal function of bones and cartilage, skin, blood vessels, gums, and teeth.

sections.heading: What is Omega 3?
sections.body: Omega 3 is the name for the family of polyunsaturated essential fatty acids found most abundantly in fish. Fish oil is an excellent source of eicosapentaenoic (EPA) acid and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA). Omega 3 has been found to support brain, vision and heart function as well as useful during pregnancy. DHA has a key structural element to the brain, retina and many other body parts. For optimal health, there is an omega 6 to omega 3 ratio that should be adhered to.

sections.heading: What Does Fish Oil Do?
sections.body: Fish oil contains EPA and DHA which both contribute to the normal function of the heart.

Royal Jelly has long been valued as a naturally nutrient-rich ingredient, making it an appealing choice for health-conscious adults looking to support their everyday immune health and overall vitality.

This product is particularly suited to busy professionals, active adults and individuals who want convenient nutritional support as part of their daily routine. sections.heading: What is VitaBlake Royal Bee?
sections.body: VitaBlake Royal Bee is made with royal jelly, a milky secretion produced by worker honey bees. It typically contains a mix of protein, amino acids and other nutrients. It gets its name from the fact that bees use it for the development and nurturing of queen bees. Royal jelly generally contains B vitamins, minerals and trace elements such as copper, iron, phosphates, potassium, silicon and sulphur.

This unique formula supports everything from immune health to cognitive function, energy, and beauty.

sections.heading: What Does DailyMax Do?
sections.body: DailyMax's unique blend of ingredients contribute to a healthy lifestyle in a number of ways. Some of these are listed below.

sections.heading: General Health & Immunity
sections.body: DailyMax provides vitamin A, B6, B12, C, D and zinc, which all contribute to the normal function of the immune system. This is alongside vitamin C which contributes to maintenance of the normal function of the immune system during and after physical exercise. Vitamin B2, C, E and manganese and zinc contribute to the protection of cells from oxidative stress. Vitamin B1, B2, B3, B6, B12 and C contribute to normal functioning of the nervous system. Vitamin A, B2 and zinc contribute to the maintenance of normal vision. Vitamin B1 contributes to the normal function of the heart.

sections.heading: Beauty
sections.body: DailyMax provides vitamin C which contributes to normal collagen formation for the normal function of blood vessels, bones, cartilage, gums, skin and teeth. Zinc contributes to the maintenance of normal hair and nails. Also in DailyMax is vitamin A, B2, B3 and zinc which all contribute to the maintenance of normal skin.

sections.heading: Energy Levels
sections.body: DailyMax provides vitamin B2, B3, B5, B6, B12 and C. All of which contribute to a reduction of tiredness and fatigue, and a normal energy yielding metabolism.

sections.heading: Mental Health
sections.body: DailyMax provides vitamin B1, B3, B6, B12 and C which contribute to normal psychological function. Zinc contributes to normal cognitive function.

sections.heading: Muscular Health
sections.body: DailyMax provides vitamin D which contributes to the maintenance of normal muscle function. There is also manganese which contributes to the normal function of connective tissue.

sections.heading: Cells, Blood and Hormones
sections.body: DailyMax contains a whole host of ingredients that contribute to the normal maintenance of cells, blood and hormones. This includes vitamin A, B2, B3, B6, B12, D, zinc and chromium.

sections.heading: Bone Health
sections.body: DailyMax provides vitamin D which contributes to the maintenance of normal bones and teeth. Zinc and manganese also contribute to the maintenance of normal bones.

sections.heading: Why Always Capsules?
sections.body: VitaBlake along with manufacturer choose plant-based vegetable cellulose capsules to provide a simple and effective way to deliver our vitamins and supplements. Unlike tablets, capsules can minimise the need for unnecessary binders, additives and sweeteners, allowing us to focus on delivering high-quality active ingredients. Our HPMC vegetable capsules are suitable for a wide range of dietary and lifestyle requirements, providing a convenient and reliable way to take your daily supplements.
